text.p: Japanese soccer team Kashima Antlers retained top place in the J.League on Wednesday after beating Jubilo Iwata 4-3 on penalties.

Brazilian striker Mazinho scored twice for Kashima Antlers to carry the match into extra-time, but with the score still locked at 2-2 after the two 15-minute periods the match was decided from the penalty spot.
In another match, Brazilian striker Evair Aparecido Paulino hammered a hat-trick of goals to guide Yokohama Flugels to a 3-1 victory against Avispa Fukuoka.
Kashima Antlers and Yokohama Flugels both have 60 points, but Kashima maintain their league lead on goal differences.
Nagoya Grampus Eight slipped to third place after losing 1-0 to Verdy Kawasaki.
